# Load and inspect data from 2019 to 2025
```{r}
#add block purpose and ECHO parameters to each chunk

#install.packages("ncdf4") if needed

library(dplyr) #data format manipulation
library(ncdf4) #read nc files (3 and 4 type)
library(purrr) #avoiding loops to extract data from vectors and then build abiotic/ nutrients tables
library(readr) #write out or read in tables
library(stringr) #similar to purrr, really great for name/ characteristic changes
library(tibble) #creating tables

nc19 <- nc_open("../data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2019.nc")
nc20 <- nc_open("../data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2020.nc")
nc21 <- nc_open("../data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2023.nc")
nc22 <- nc_open("../data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2022.nc")
nc23 <- nc_open("../data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2023.nc")
nc24 <- nc_open("../data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2024.nc")
nc25 <- nc_open("../data/raw/MarineWaterProfilesAndNutrientsYear2025.nc")

#glimpse(ncXX)

```

## Year: 2019
### Extract metadata and change vectors to usable data tables
```{r}

# 1. Station-level metadata
stations <- tibble(station_number = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "station_number")), station_name = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "Station")), latitude = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "Latitude")), longitude = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "Longitude")))

# 2. Profile-level metadata
profiles <- tibble(profile_index = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "profile_index")), station_number = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "station_index")), field_date = as.Date(as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "FieldDate")), origin = "1970-01-01"))

# 3. Observation-level measurements
observations <- tibble(
  profile_index = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "obs_index")),
  depth_m = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "Depth")),

  temperature = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "Temp")),
  salinity = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "Salinity")),
  dissolved_oxygen = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "DOAdjusted")),

  nitrate = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "NO3")),
  nitrite = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "NO2")),
  ammonium = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "NH4")),
  phosphate = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "PO4")),
  silicate = as.vector(ncvar_get(nc19, "SiOH4"))
)

# 4. Join measurements to profiles and stations
water_quality19 <- observations %>%
  left_join(
    profiles,
    by = "profile_index",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    stations,
    by = "station_number",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

nc_close(nc19)

# Verify resulting dataset
#glimpse(water_quality19)

write_csv(water_quality19, "../data/interim/water_quality19.csv")

```

## For water quality data, filter any depths beyond 13m (limit of where mussel ropes extend) 
```{r}

# Depth-appropriate abiotic measurements
abiotic_rope19 <- water_quality19 %>%
  filter(between(depth_m, 0, 13)) %>%
  select(
    field_date,
    profile_index,
    station_number,
    station_name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    depth_m,
    temperature,
    salinity,
    dissolved_oxygen
  )

# Nutrients at all sampled depths
nutrients19 <- water_quality19 %>%
  filter(
    if_any(
      c(nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate, silicate),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    field_date,
    profile_index,
    station_number,
    station_name,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    depth_m,
    nitrate,
    nitrite,
    ammonium,
    phosphate,
    silicate
  )

write_csv(abiotic_rope19, "../data/working/abiotic_rope_19.csv")
write_csv(nutrients19, "../data/working/nutrients_19.csv")

```

# Combine all water quality and all nutrients to create two complete tables.
## 2019-2025
```{r}

# Directory where tables exist
data_dir <- "../data/working"

# Find files
abiotic_files <- list.files(
  data_dir,
  pattern = "^abiotic_rope_[0-9]{2}\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

nutrient_files <- list.files(
  data_dir,
  pattern = "^nutrients_[0-9]{2}\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Function to import and label each year
combine_years <- function(files) {
  map_dfr(files, function(file) {
    year <- as.integer(
      str_extract(basename(file), "[0-9]{2}")
    )

    read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(sample_year = year, .before = 1)
  })
}

# Create combined datasets
abiotic_all <- combine_years(abiotic_files)

nutrients_all <- combine_years(nutrient_files)

# double check site profiles are not misrepresented
abiotic_all <- abiotic_all %>%
  mutate(
    profile_uid = paste(sample_year, profile_index, sep = "_"),
    .after = profile_index
  )

nutrients_all <- nutrients_all %>%
  mutate(
    profile_uid = paste(sample_year, profile_index, sep = "_"),
    .after = profile_index
  )

# write out combined tables for EA
write_csv(abiotic_all, "../data/working/abiotic_all.csv")
write_csv(nutrients_all, "../data/working/nutrients_all.csv")

```
